GreenBoost Plant Food Tablets: Instructions

Each tablet contains 2 mg of slow-release nitrogen and lasts for about six weeks.

Push one tablet into the soil near the edge of the pot for plants up to 20 centimetres tall. Use two tablets for larger plants.

Do not use on cacti or orchids.

Store the tablets in a dry place, out of reach of children and pets.
